name: Toushuusai Sharaku
source:
Died at the age of 18.

Known as an ukiyo-e artist in his past life. Sharaku is a spendthrift, as well as a homemaker obsessed with keeping things neat and tidy.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/sharaku/]Aksys Games[/url]]
